description: Physically correct noise model comparison (qubit vs qudit)

checks.name: cx_per_pair_gate_in_simulate
checks.detail: simulate() should accept cx_per_pair_gate parameter

checks.name: effective_rate_formula
checks.detail: Should compute p_eff = 1 - (1-depol_2q)^cx_per_pair_gate

checks.name: depol_2q_eff_in_noise_loop
checks.detail: Should use depol_2q_eff (effective rate) in noise application

checks.name: estimate_cx_method
checks.detail: Should have estimate_cx_per_pair_gate() method

checks.name: cx_per_pair_gate_default_1
checks.detail: Default cx_per_pair_gate should be 1 (backward compatible)

checks.name: cx_per_pair_gate_validation
checks.detail: Should validate cx_per_pair_gate >= 1

checks.name: output_contains_cx_info
checks.detail: Return dict should include cx_per_pair_gate and depol_2q_effective

checks.name: no_qiskit_aer_import
checks.detail: qubit_noisy_simulator should NOT import Qiskit Aer for simulation

checks.name: density_matrix_method
checks.detail: Should have density matrix depolarizing channel method

checks.name: pair_unitary_builder
checks.detail: Should have per-pair unitary builder

checks.name: d_equals_4
checks.detail: Local dimension should be d=4 (2 qubits per molecule)

checks.name: qudit_d_equals_3
checks.detail: Qudit local dimension should be d=3 (qutrit)

checks.name: qudit_depolarizing_method
checks.detail: Should have 2-qudit depolarizing channel method

checks.name: qudit_I_over_d_squared
checks.detail: Should use I/d for each qudit (not I/d^2 for the pair)

checks.name: qudit_no_cx_overhead
checks.detail: Qudit simulator should NOT have cx_per_pair_gate (native gates)

checks.name: qubit_depol_channel_formula
checks.detail: Qubit channel: ε(ρ) = (1-p)ρ + p·Tr_{ij}(ρ)⊗I_{16}/16

checks.name: qudit_depol_channel_formula
checks.detail: Qudit channel: ε(ρ) = (1-p)ρ + p·Tr_{ij}(ρ)⊗I_9/9

checks.name: qubit_forbidden_state_doc
checks.detail: Qubit simulator should document forbidden state leakage

checks.name: cx_count_positive
checks.detail: CX counts should be positive: transfer=47, tta=86

checks.name: cx_count_reasonable
checks.detail: Average CX count (66.5) should be between 2 and 100

checks.name: effective_rate_monotonic
checks.detail: Effective rate should increase monotonically with CX count

checks.name: qubit_more_noisy_than_qudit
checks.detail: Qubit effective rate (6.4368%) > Qudit rate (0.1000%) for CX/pair=66.5

checks.name: qubit_leakage_theory
checks.detail: Qubit leakage fraction = 7/16 = 0.4375 (theory: 7/16 = 0.4375)

checks.name: qudit_no_leakage_theory
checks.detail: Qudit has zero forbidden states (all d=3 states are physical)
